########################################

# Figure assembly LongAIRR Figure 6
#
########################################

```{r}
library(png)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```

#read in intermediates
```{r}
#richness + ucell
p6_a <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_a.rds")
p6_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_b.rds")

#clone + lineage
p6_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_c.rds")
p6_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_d_full.rds")

#zoom-in + ucell
p6_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_e.rds")
p6_f <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel6/intermediates/p6_f.rds")
```

#set up figure size
```{r}
FINAL_WIDTH <- 7.5
FINAL_HEIGHT <- 8
FIG_MARGIN <- 2

canvas_width <- FINAL_WIDTH - 2 * FIG_MARGIN / 72.27
canvas_height <- FINAL_HEIGHT - 2 * FIG_MARGIN / 72.27
panel_margin <- theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
```

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=8}
# Extract tissue panels and legends.
richness_panel <- cowplot::get_panel(p6_a + theme(legend.position = "none"))
spatial_panel <- cowplot::get_panel(p6_c + theme(legend.position = "none"))
zoom_panel <- cowplot::get_panel(p6_e + theme(legend.position = "none"))

richness_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p6_a)
spatial_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p6_c)
selected_spot_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p6_e)

#same scaling for tissue figures in the left panel column
tissue_left <- 0.005
tissue_width <- 0.405
tissue_height <- tissue_width * abs(diff(tissue_y_limits) / diff(tissue_x_limits)) *
  canvas_width / canvas_height

richness_top <- 0.98
richness_bottom <- richness_top - tissue_height
richness_legend_y <- richness_bottom - 0.05

spatial_top <- richness_legend_y - 0.018
spatial_bottom <- spatial_top - tissue_height
spatial_legend_y <- spatial_bottom - 0.03

zoom_top <- spatial_legend_y - 0.028
zoom_aspect <- abs(diff(zoom_y_limits) / diff(zoom_x_limits)) * canvas_width / canvas_height
zoom_width <- min(tissue_width, (zoom_top - 0.005) / zoom_aspect)
zoom_height <- zoom_width * zoom_aspect
zoom_left <- tissue_left + (tissue_width - zoom_width) / 2
zoom_bottom <- zoom_top - zoom_height

# lineage gets more space in right column
right_left <- 0.48
right_width <- 0.515
#right_width <- 0.58
region_bottom <- 0.72
lineage_top <- 0.69
lineage_bottom <- 0.285
expression_top <- 0.255

```

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=8}
p6_final <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(richness_panel, x = tissue_left, y = richness_bottom, width = tissue_width, height = tissue_height, clip = "on") +
  cowplot::draw_grob(richness_legend, x = tissue_left, y = richness_legend_y, width = tissue_width, height = 0.05) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(p6_b + panel_margin, x = right_left, y = region_bottom, width = right_width, height = richness_top - region_bottom) +
  cowplot::draw_grob(spatial_panel, x = tissue_left, y = spatial_bottom, width = tissue_width, height = tissue_height, clip = "on") +
  cowplot::draw_grob(spatial_legend, x = tissue_left, y = spatial_legend_y, width = 0.465, height = 0.03) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(p6_d + panel_margin, x = right_left, y = lineage_bottom, width = 0.58, height = lineage_top - lineage_bottom) +
  cowplot::draw_grob(zoom_panel, x = zoom_left, y = zoom_bottom, width = zoom_width, height = zoom_height, clip = "on") +
  cowplot::draw_plot(p6_f + panel_margin + theme(legend.position = "none"), x = right_left, y = 0.055, width = right_width, height = expression_top - 0.055) +
  cowplot::draw_grob(selected_spot_legend, x = right_left, y = 0.005, width = right_width, height = 0.04) +
  cowplot::draw_plot_label(c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"), 
                           x = c(tissue_left, right_left, tissue_left, right_left, tissue_left, right_left),
                           y = c(0.998, 0.998, spatial_top + 0.016, lineage_top + 0.018,
                           zoom_top + 0.025, expression_top + 0.018), size = 7, hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(FIG_MARGIN, FIG_MARGIN, FIG_MARGIN, FIG_MARGIN))


p6_final
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p6_full.pdf", plot=p6_final, width = 7.5, height = 8)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p6_full.png", plot=p6_final, width = 7.5, height = 8)
```
